曹大军心想：“你家长辈谁呀？还要收我儿子当弟子，是攀交情的吧！”

刚要上前拒绝，陈近岳就一把把曹大军拉了回来，问道：“小野说的长辈可是赵老？”

王野点头称是，曹大军一听陈近岳称呼对方叫赵老，就知道这人不简单。转头就问：“陈大哥，你说的赵老是？”

陈近岳小声说：“八极震九州。”

曹大军瞪大眼睛：“卧槽！这位怎么看上我家傻小子了？”

陈近岳说：“先别管怎么看上的，赶紧备礼去一趟吧！这可是强子的机缘。”

曹大军笑呵呵的说：“对对，先去一趟，这可是大机缘，必须去一趟。”说完就往外走，边走边说：“强子，你和小兄弟等我一下，我马上就回来。”

陈近岳说：“小野别见怪，这货就这脾气。”

王野说：“陈大爷客气了，今天有强子这事儿就不多打扰了，改日再登门拜访。”

陈近岳笑呵呵的说：“你们先去忙，没事儿来家里玩儿。”

曹家现在可热闹了，曹大军一回家就开始翻箱倒柜。

曹母见自己丈夫回来就找东西，就问：“大军，这是怎么了？”

曹大军“哈哈”笑着说：“你家傻儿子攀上高枝了，哈哈！这下你儿子再也不用老子发愁了！”

曹母疑惑的说：“什么攀上高枝了，这是哪家首长的闺女看上强子了？”

曹大军：“去一边去，你个傻老娘们儿，我就这么一个儿子，我还能让我儿子去当上门女婿呀？我曹大军也用不上这么去巴结领导呀！”

曹母更疑惑了问：“那你倒是给我说说怎么回事儿呀？”

曹大军大笑着说：“哈哈哈，我儿子被有大本事的人看上了，要教我儿子本事。”

曹母说：“咱那傻儿子有什么能被人看上的，看他力气大呀？”

曹大军一顿，说：“对，就是看我儿子力气大。”

曹大军从柜子里拿出了两瓶茅台，两条中华，两个木盒的茶叶装在一个袋子里就往外走，刚走出去两步就又回来了，对着曹母说：“你收拾一下也跟着去，这是儿子的大事儿，必须重视。”曹母赶紧收拾了一下跟了出来。

王野和强子已经来到曹家院子。曹大军见王野在院子里就说：“小兄弟，让你久等了。”

王野说：“曹大爷客气了，您叫我小野就行了。”

曹大军说：“好好，小野，咱这就走吧！别让赵老等急了。”

强子骑车带着王野，曹大军和曹母各骑一辆自行车出了大院。

一行四人很快就到了王野家，曹大军到了门口还特意整理了一下衣服。在王野的引领下，曹家三口进入了赵爷爷的屋子。

王野上前一步说：“赵爷爷，这就是强子的父母。”

曹大军上前一步，郑重的敬了一个军礼：“原保卫旅旅长曹大军向赵老问好。”

赵爷爷恍然大悟的哦了一声说：“哦......我说怎么听曹黑子怎么这么耳熟呢，原来是你呀！强子长得这么壮，合着是你家的种呀！倒也合理。”

曹大军嘿嘿一笑说：“那个赵老，我听我家强子说，您老要收他当弟子呀？”

听到“弟子”两字赵爷爷还没说，王野可不干了，开什么玩笑呀。

Cao Dajun thought to himself: "Who is your elder? You want to accept my son as a disciple. Is it because of friendship?"

Just as he was about to step forward to refuse, Chen Jinyue pulled Cao Dajun back and asked, "Is the elder Xiaoye mentioned Mr. Zhao?"

Wang Ye nodded in agreement. As soon as Cao Dajun heard Chen Jinyue call him Mr. Zhao, he knew that this person was not a simple person.He turned around and asked: "Brother Chen, is Mr. Zhao you talking about?"

Chen Jinyue said in a low voice: "The Eight Extremes shook Kyushu."

Cao Dajun's eyes widened: "Damn it! Why does this guy fall in love with my stupid boy?"

Chen Jinyue said: "Don't worry about why you fell in love with me, hurry up and prepare a gift! This is Qiangzi's opportunity."

Cao Dajun said with a smile: "That's right, let's go first. This is a great opportunity. We must go there." After that, he walked out and said as he walked: "Qiangzi, you and the little brother wait for me, I will be back soon."

Chen Jinyue said: "Don't be offended, Xiaoye, this guy has this temper."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle Chen, you're too polite. I won't bother you too much because there is a strong son today. I'll visit you another day."

Chen Jinyue said with a smile: "You go and do your work first. Come and play at home if you have nothing to do."

The Cao family is very lively now. Cao Dajun started rummaging through boxes and cabinets as soon as he came home.

Seeing that her husband was looking for something when he came back, Cao's mother asked, "Dajun, what's going on?"

Cao Dajun said with a "haha" smile: "Your silly son has climbed up a high branch, haha! Now your son no longer has to worry about me!"

Cao's mother said doubtfully: "What's so high? Is this the leader's daughter who has fallen in love with a strong son?"

Cao Dajun: "Go away, you silly old bitch, I only have a son, how can I let my son be my son-in-law? I, Cao Dajun, don't have to flatter the leader like this!"

Mother Cao was even more confused and asked: "Then tell me what's going on?"

Cao Dajun laughed and said: "Hahaha, my son has been spotted by someone with great ability and wants to teach my son his ability."

Cao's mother said: "What can people like about our silly son? How strong is he?"

Cao Dajun paused and said, "Yes, just to see how strong my son is."

Cao Dajun took out two bottles of Maotai, two bottles of Chinese tea, and two wooden boxes of tea from the cabinet, put them in a bag, and walked out. He came back after just two steps and said to Cao's mother: "You pack up and follow. This is an important matter for my son, and we must pay attention to it." Cao's mother quickly packed up and followed out.

Wang Ye and Qiangzi have arrived at the Cao family yard.When Cao Dajun saw Wang Ye in the yard, he said, "Little brother, I kept you waiting for a long time."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle Cao, you're welcome. Just call me Xiaoye."

Cao Dajun said: "Okay, Xiaoye, let's leave now! Don't let Mr. Zhao wait in a hurry."

Qiangzi took Wang Ye with him on a bicycle, and Cao Dajun and Cao's mother each rode a bicycle out of the compound.

The group of four people arrived at Wang Ye's house quickly. Cao Dajun even tidied his clothes when he arrived at the door.Under the guidance of Wang Ye, the three members of the Cao family entered Grandpa Zhao's house.

Wang Ye took a step forward and said, "Grandpa Zhao, these are Qiangzi's parents."

Cao Dajun took a step forward and solemnly saluted with a military salute: "Cao Dajun, the former commander of the security brigade, said hello to Mr. Zhao."

Grandpa Zhao suddenly realized and said, "Oh... I wonder why Cao Heizi sounds so familiar to me. It's you! Qiangzi is so strong, so the co-author is from your family! It makes sense."

Cao Dajun chuckled and said, "That Mr. Zhao, I heard from my Qiangzi that you always want to accept him as your disciple?"

Before Grandpa Zhao said the word "disciple", Wang Ye would quit. What a joke.
